posts.title: Posts
posts.intro: Every shout-out in every state. Open a post to read it in full. Hidden posts disappear from the feed, profiles, leaderboards and points until you unhide them. Deleting is permanent.

warning.title: Warning: deleting a post can't be undone
warning.body: Changes here take effect straight away. A deleted post is gone for good from the feed, profiles, leaderboards and points. A hidden post stays hidden until an admin unhides it.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.explain: A pair shows up here when they shouted each other out at least 3 times in the same calendar month. One time means A recognised B and B recognised A, so the count is the smaller of the two directions. Only live posts count. It's a prompt to take a look, not proof of anything.

slt.title: SLT shout-out
slt.intro: Post a shout-out on behalf of the Senior Leadership Team. It is the highest recognition: on the newsfeed it has a gold frame and is shown as from the Senior Leadership Team, not from you. The people recognised get their usual points.
slt.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters of a name.

auctions.title: Add auction item
auctions.intro: List something people can bid their OurShout points on. It appears on the Auction Table straight away, marked as coming soon until bidding starts. The highest bid when bidding ends wins, and those points come off the winner's total.

fields.imageHint: Optional. PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF, up to 5 MB.
fields.timeNote: Times are in your own time zone.

errors.imageType: The picture must be a PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF.
